title: Thin Atmosphere
body:
## Why use this plugin?
This plugin adds extra challenge to the game, whether you want players to struggle climbing mountains or suffer on a moon-like planet with pockets of air deep underground, it's up to you with **Thin Atmosphere**. Even if you just want to discourage players from being too high up, it'll work for that too.

## How the plugin works
When a player goes above the `start-altitude` value, they begin to lose air bubbles as if they were drowning. The higher up they go, the faster the air bubbles are lost until they reach the `end-altitude` value, at which point they should be dead.

## Showcase GIF
![Once the player reaches a certain altitude, they start losing air bubbles, and then take damage until they die](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/LtMKq7lC/images/9e58654966aae12ae8a7a83d4c82fcfab1990caa.gif)

## Config
`ticks-per-decrease` - Air bubbles decrease every x amount of ticks, 5 seems rather stable in my testing  
`start-altitude` - The altitude where players start to lose air at  
`end-altitude` - What altitude the player loses all air at (unless multiply-diff enabled)  
`multiply-diff` - Multiplies altitude difference by 4, makes air loss more gradual  
`offset` - Helps prevent oxygen bubbles from flickering, increase until flickering stops, may need to decrease if `multiply-diff` is off
